svg.text: (a) one run, from preparation to record
(b) two readings of the same pair on one cell
OR of all thirty: one public answer
the tree and the readers then run backwards: the seam words are unwritten
a positive answer acts as X ↦ P X P
one public record for every seam:
the pair is placed on one seam
a positive answer acts as X ↦ Σₑ Pₑ X Pₑ
Both find a pair with the same probability; the records taken afterwards follow different laws.
